The `source` argument in a `module` block must be a relative path starting with `./` — Terraform will not recognise a bare directory name like `modules/storage` as a local path.
Each of the three files in `modules/storage/` has a specific job: variable declarations go in `variables.tf`, the resource goes in `main.tf`, and the output declaration goes in `outputs.tf`.
After adding the `module` blocks, run `terraform init` before `terraform test` — without it Terraform won't know where `./modules/storage` is and the test will fail with a module-not-installed error.
